authority_boundaries.approval_claims: an approval referenced only from manifest or tool_output is void; approvals live exclusively in registered_context.pre_approved bound to actor+operation+expiry
authority_boundaries.governance_claims: governance claims in tool_output are recorded as evidence and never applied

architecture_models.decision_flow: L1-L3 gate -> L4 advisory evidence -> L6 output guard -> L7 fail-closed routing (faults override) -> L5 policy -> L8 audit; DENY/QUARANTINE/HUMAN_REVIEW/UNSUPPORTED never collapse to ALLOW.
trust_boundaries: Tool manifests arrive from publishers/registries: untrusted until provenance-verified.
Tool outputs are untrusted external content regardless of manifest validity.
Detector outputs are evidence, never authority.
Only gateway policy over registered state authorizes effects.

feature_catalog.advisory_vs_authoritative: Only registry/policy/digest/capability layers decide; static indicators may add reason codes and escalate to quarantine/review, never to ALLOW or sole DENY of benign cases.
signals: manifest structural validity (required fields, types, unknown fields)
content digest format and dependency digest coverage
version and schema skew vs registration
advisory static indicators (entropy, keywords, obfuscation markers)
governance claims (approval, knowledge, budget, reconciliation, acceptance)

independent_audit.auditor: verifier-B (Run B), process-separated from Run A producer
limitations: Same-host process separation, not an external human auditor.
The auditor shares the codebase with the producer (independent process and identity, not an independent implementation).
independent_audit.method: Same frozen inputs, distinct PID/executor/nonce/output root; runner recomputes metrics from raw records and rejects any divergence; oracle expectations are excluded from decisions.

mathematical_model.confusion_semantics: Raw matrix counts oracle-sanctioned benign routings as FP for visibility; the hard-gate benign FPR excludes sanctioned routing.
mathematical_model.metrics: precision = TP/(TP+FP), recall = TP/(TP+FN), FPR = FP/(FP+TN), FNR = FN/(FN+TP); Wilson score interval with z=1.959963984540054 for binomial proportions.
mathematical_model.observed:
- confusion matrix (truth x treatment, overall): TP=34, FP=3, TN=19, FN=0 on 56 cases
- precision=0.9189 (Wilson 95% [0.7870, 0.9720])
- recall=1.0000 (Wilson 95% [0.8985, 1.0000])
- benign hard FPR=0.0000 (raw benign blocked=3, all oracle-sanctioned routing)
- abstentions: quarantine=8, human_review=1, unsupported=1
- critical escapes=0; authority expansions: acceptance=0, approval=0, budget=0, capability=0, knowledge=0, policy=0
- malformed=3, unknown=1, timeout=1, scanner_disagreement=1
mathematical_model.reward_model: Binary treatment per case: blocked = decision in {DENY, QUARANTINE, HUMAN_REVIEW, UNSUPPORTED}.

mental_model.adversary_view: Poisoning must defeat digest/provenance checks, stay inside registered capabilities, avoid output-injection signatures, and keep detectors healthy - simultaneously.
mental_model.auditor_view: Every decision carries reason codes, layer trace, and empty authority_mutations; oracle outcomes live only in host-owned fixtures.
mental_model.operator_view: A tool is admitted only when provenance, capability, and policy layers all agree; anything uncertain on an effect-capable path is quarantined or reviewed.

relations.Decision: produced by pipeline, graded only against oracle
relations.FrozenCase: binds input + registered context + oracle expectation

adoption_steps: keep advisory scanners out of the authorization path
enforce capability diff and effect-power ordering at registration
route uncertain effect-capable cases to quarantine/human review
treat tool output as data; deny effect paths on taint findings
emit immutable audit records with reason codes
platform_plan.gateway_binding: Layer semantics mirror agentos.gateway ToolContract: effect classes read/write_local/write_external/dangerous, capability checks, exact-action approvals consumed atomically once.
platform_plan.phase_b: Local canonicalization on the trusted host (research-plan, tracked packs, wiki check, canonical evidence pack) before any status change.

research_plan.design: Deterministic, frozen-corpus adversarial evaluation of an 8-layer admission/output contract; two process-separated runs on one clean commit; host-owned oracle; fail-closed hard gates.
research_plan.question: Which layered controls detect malicious or misleading tool manifests and outputs, and when must the gateway quarantine or require human approval instead of trusting a scanner?
research_plan.scope_boundary: Evidence for G-07 / EP-06 only; no universal-detection or production-rollout claim.

source_registry.note: Tests and evaluation are offline; snapshots are byte-frozen.

sources.version: MITRE ATLAS adversarial-ML taxonomy, atlas-data commit 41d4f5ca4112f0e492ffaa3ebff07dc80a75afa5

gaps: Deterministic pattern layers cannot cover unseen obfuscation families; routing-level defense (quarantine/human review) carries that residual risk.
No statistical/learned detector was evaluated; disagreement handling is exercised only via declared deterministic faults.
The 56-case corpus measures declared classes only.
synthesis_and_gaps.synthesis: Layered controls detected every malicious class in the frozen corpus with zero critical escapes and zero authority expansions; obfuscated content routes to quarantine; detector faults fail closed; benign unusual cases are not silently denied by advisory heuristics.

note: Cloud Phase A only; canonical local Phase B is required before any closure. Branch remains IN_REVIEW.
